title: Wyze camera not recording motion events
shortDescription: Motion events don't appear in the Events tab.
fullDescription: Wyze uses cloud-based event recording. Failures usually come from a disabled detection zone, Cam Plus/Unlimited subscription issue, or an offline camera. Verify motion detection is enabled, check detection zone doesn't mask the area, and confirm subscription status.

fixSteps.title: Enable detection
fixSteps.instruction: Camera settings > Event Recording > Motion on.

fixSteps.title: Review detection zone
fixSteps.instruction: Adjust zone grid to cover target area.

fixSteps.title: Check subscription
fixSteps.instruction: Account > Services; renew Cam Plus if needed.

videoSearchQuery: Wyze camera not recording events fix

title: Wyze camera live view won't load
shortDescription: Live stream shows spinning wheel or error message.
fullDescription: Live-stream failures trace to weak Wi-Fi at camera, app server congestion, or camera firmware hang. Power-cycle the camera (unplug 10s), reboot the phone's Wi-Fi, and check for firmware update.

fixSteps.title: Check signal
fixSteps.instruction: Camera info screen — should show >2 bars.

fixSteps.title: Move camera or add extender
fixSteps.instruction: Relocate closer to router or add Wi-Fi extender.

title: Wyze auth error on login
fullDescription: Auth failures may be due to incorrect password, 2FA code delay, or region mismatch. Reset password via email, check SMS/authenticator app delivery, and confirm the account region matches.

fixSteps.title: Reset password
fixSteps.instruction: Use Forgot Password link in Wyze app.

title: Wyze camera weak Wi-Fi signal
shortDescription: Camera frequently offline or slow to load.
fullDescription: Wyze cameras support 2.4GHz only. Weak signal causes dropouts. Check RSSI in camera info — values worse than -70 dBm cause problems. Add Wi-Fi extender or Mesh node near camera.

fixSteps.title: Add extender
fixSteps.instruction: Install Wi-Fi extender within 20 ft of camera.

title: Wyze firmware update stuck or failing
fullDescription: OTA updates fail if Wi-Fi drops mid-transfer. Wyze publishes recovery flashing via microSD — copy demo.bin to SD, insert, and power up with setup button held.

fixSteps.title: microSD recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Copy demo.bin to FAT32 SD, insert, hold setup button while powering.

title: Wyze night vision won't activate
shortDescription: Camera stays in color when dark.
fullDescription: Night vision requires IR LEDs active and setting enabled. Toggle Night Vision to Auto. IR LEDs glow dim red if working — if not, check behind glass (IR reflects back) and ensure firmware is current.

fixSteps.title: Enable Night Vision
fixSteps.instruction: Live view > night vision icon > Auto.

fixSteps.title: Move off glass
fixSteps.instruction: Don't point camera through window at night.

whenToCallPro: Wyze support for LED hardware failure.
videoSearchQuery: Wyze night vision not working fix

title: Wyze microSD card not recognized
shortDescription: SD card not detected for local recording.
fullDescription: Wyze supports Class 10 microSD up to 256GB (v3 Pro supports 512GB). Cards must be formatted FAT32 or exFAT. If not recognized, format via the Wyze app, or format on PC to FAT32.

fixSteps.title: Format on PC
fixSteps.instruction: FAT32 format on computer if app fails.

fixSteps.title: Replace card
fixSteps.instruction: Try new Class 10 microSD if persistent.

affectedModels: All Wyze cameras with SD slot
videoSearchQuery: Wyze SD card not detected fix

title: Wyze camera setup fails during onboarding
shortDescription: QR scan or Wi-Fi credential step fails.
fullDescription: Setup requires 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, correct password, and good camera light for QR scan. Hold phone ~6 inches from camera, in even lighting. Ensure SSID has no special characters.
symptoms: Setup hangs at QR or Wi-Fi step

fixSteps.title: 2.4GHz SSID
fixSteps.instruction: Connect phone to 2.4GHz network during setup.

fixSteps.title: QR positioning
fixSteps.instruction: 6 inches from camera lens, even light.

title: Wyze two-way audio fails
shortDescription: Microphone or speaker silent during talk-back.
fullDescription: Two-way audio needs microphone permission for Wyze app and camera speaker functional. Grant iOS/Android mic permission, then restart camera to clear audio pipeline.
videoSearchQuery: Wyze two way audio not working fix

title: Wyze Cam Plus features missing despite subscription
shortDescription: Full-length events, person detection, or AI features not working.
fullDescription: Cam Plus licenses must be assigned to specific cameras. After purchasing, go to Services > Cam Plus > Manage > assign to each camera. New cameras don't auto-inherit licenses.

fixSteps.title: Assign license
fixSteps.instruction: Account > Services > Cam Plus > Manage > assign camera.

videoSearchQuery: Wyze Cam Plus not working assign license

title: Wyze Error 06 authentication failure
shortDescription: Camera fails to authenticate with cloud.
fullDescription: Error 06 indicates the camera token is invalid or the account session expired. Sign out, reboot router, and re-add the device.

fixSteps.title: Sign out
fixSteps.instruction: Account > Sign Out, then back in.

fixSteps.title: Re-add device
fixSteps.instruction: Remove from app and run setup again.

title: Wyze Error 09 device binding failure
shortDescription: Setup or reconnect aborts with Error 09.
fullDescription: Error 09 occurs when the camera cannot bind to the account, usually due to a previous owner or stuck server record. Factory reset and try a different account if persistent.

fixSteps.title: Retry setup
fixSteps.instruction: Run Add Device with QR code closer to lens.

fixSteps.title: Contact support
fixSteps.instruction: Open ticket if Error 09 persists after reset.

whenToCallPro: Contact Wyze support if reset doesn't clear.

title: Wyze Error 90 stream timeout
shortDescription: Live view fails after a few seconds with Error 90.
fullDescription: Error 90 is a connection-timeout. Caused by weak Wi-Fi at the camera, ISP latency, or congested 2.4GHz band.

title: Wyze SD card not detected
shortDescription: Storage tab shows No SD Card despite a card being inserted.
fullDescription: MicroSD failures arise from incompatible card class, unformatted FAT32, or worn flash. Use a Class 10 card 32-256GB and format in-camera.

fixSteps.title: Reseat card
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, remove and reinsert card firmly.

videoSearchQuery: Wyze security camera SD CARD NOT RECOGNIZED fix

title: Wyze camera will not join Wi-Fi
shortDescription: Setup fails at Connecting to Wi-Fi step.
fullDescription: Wyze cameras require 2.4GHz only. Mixed-band SSIDs, hidden networks, or special characters in the password block setup.

fixSteps.title: Simplify password
fixSteps.instruction: Use alphanumerics during setup, restore after.

videoSearchQuery: Wyze security camera WIFI CANNOT CONNECT fix

title: Wyze camera reports cannot connect to cloud
shortDescription: Camera online on Wi-Fi but app shows cloud error.
fullDescription: Router blocks UDP ports or DNS resolution fails. Some mesh systems and ISP-supplied routers filter Wyze traffic.

fixSteps.title: Disable AP isolation
fixSteps.instruction: Router admin > Wireless > AP Isolation off.

videoSearchQuery: Wyze security camera CANNOT CONNECT TO CLOUD fix

title: Wyze camera misses motion events
shortDescription: PIR/AI motion detection misses obvious activity.
fullDescription: Outdoor cams (PIR) miss motion through glass; v3 pixel-based detection needs proper sensitivity. AI Detection requires Cam Plus subscription.
videoSearchQuery: Wyze security camera MOTION NOT DETECTING fix

title: Wyze night vision IR not working
shortDescription: Image stays black or grayscale washed in dark.
fullDescription: IR LEDs may be disabled in settings, blocked by housing condensation, or burnt out after years of use.

fixSteps.title: Replace camera
fixSteps.instruction: If IR LEDs failed (out of warranty).

videoSearchQuery: Wyze security camera NIGHT VISION FAILED fix

title: Wyze firmware upgrade aborts
shortDescription: OTA firmware fails midway, camera reboots loop.
fullDescription: Failed firmware updates usually trace to weak Wi-Fi, low SD card space, or interrupted power. Use Manual Flash via SD card to recover.

fixSteps.title: Retry near router
fixSteps.instruction: Place camera at router, retry update.

fixSteps.title: Manual SD flash
fixSteps.instruction: Download bin, place on SD as demo.bin, hold Setup while plugging power.

videoSearchQuery: Wyze security camera FIRMWARE UPDATE FAILED fix

title: Wyze app stuck on 2FA verification
shortDescription: Code never arrives or app rejects valid code.
fullDescription: Two-factor SMS/email may be delayed, in spam, or tied to old phone. Use Authenticator app option as backup.

fixSteps.title: Check spam
fixSteps.instruction: Look in spam/junk for verification code.

fixSteps.title: Update phone
fixSteps.instruction: Replace phone number with current via support.

title: Wyze Error 91 connection lost
fullDescription: Error 91 indicates the camera lost authenticated connection to Wyze servers. Usually router DHCP lease cycling, IPv6 conflicts, or transient packet loss. Reserve a DHCP lease for the camera and disable IPv6 on guest network.

fixSteps.title: Reserve DHCP lease
fixSteps.instruction: Router admin > DHCP reservations > add camera MAC.

fixSteps.title: Disable IPv6 on SSID
fixSteps.instruction: Router settings > IPv6 off if cameras on guest band.

title: Wyze Error 92 device offline
shortDescription: App shows camera as offline with code 92.
fullDescription: Error 92 means the cloud cannot reach the camera. Most often caused by ISP DNS hijacking, double-NAT, or the camera being on a different VLAN than the phone during setup.

fixSteps.title: Disable double-NAT
fixSteps.instruction: Set ISP modem to bridge mode.

fixSteps.title: Re-add camera on same VLAN
fixSteps.instruction: Setup phone on same SSID as camera.

title: Wyze Error 95 cannot retrieve device info
shortDescription: App returns error 95 opening camera settings.
fullDescription: Error 95 occurs when the app cannot pull device metadata. Linked to expired auth tokens, account region drift, or stale app cache.

fixSteps.title: Force-stop app and clear cache
fixSteps.instruction: Phone settings > Apps > Wyze > Storage > Clear cache.

fixSteps.title: Contact support for region
fixSteps.instruction: If account region was changed support must reset.

title: Wyze Error 99 unknown error
shortDescription: Generic error 99 banner during live view.
fullDescription: Error 99 is a catch-all for unhandled exceptions. Usually firmware mismatch between app and camera or partial firmware download.

fixSteps.title: Update app
fixSteps.instruction: Play Store / App Store > Wyze > update.

title: Wyze RTSP firmware stream not accessible
shortDescription: RTSP URL won't open in VLC or NVR.
fullDescription: Wyze RTSP firmware is unmaintained. Streams fail when bitrate climbs, or after a normal firmware update overwrites the RTSP build.

fixSteps.title: Re-flash RTSP firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Wyze RTSP firmware page > download .bin > side-load via SD card.

title: Wyze person detection misses people
shortDescription: Cam Plus person tag never appears.
fullDescription: Wyze Edge AI requires v3 or newer hardware and Cam Plus subscription. Older cams use cloud AI which can lag or skip when many cameras share account.

causes.cause: Camera too old for Edge AI

fixSteps.title: Verify Cam Plus on device
fixSteps.instruction: Account > Services > Cam Plus > add device.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware for Edge AI
fixSteps.instruction: Required on v3 Pro / Cam OG.

title: Wyze Error 06 invalid auth token
shortDescription: Camera prompts to log in repeatedly.
fullDescription: Token corruption after Wyze backend updates. Usually clears with sign-out / sign-in. If persistent on iOS, the keychain entry needs deletion.

fixSteps.title: Sign out
fixSteps.instruction: Account > Sign out > sign back in.

fixSteps.title: Delete keychain entry
fixSteps.instruction: iOS settings > passwords > delete Wyze entry.

title: Wyze Cam Outdoor base offline
fullDescription: Wyze Cam Outdoor uses a base station hub. Base disconnect comes from Ethernet flapping, base power adapter weak, or base firmware stuck.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Ethernet
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and replug LAN cable both ends.

title: Wyze continuous recording to SD card stopped
fullDescription: Continuous recording stops if SD card has bad sectors, format isn't FAT32/exFAT, or scheduled rule paused recording.

fixSteps.title: Check Rules
fixSteps.instruction: Wyze Rules > look for paused recording.

title: Wyze Cam Plus Lite recording lapsed
shortDescription: Free Cam Plus Lite stopped capturing 12s clips.
fullDescription: Cam Plus Lite requires periodic re-confirmation of pay-what-you-want. If billing email lapses, free tier reverts to 5-minute cooldown.

fixSteps.title: Renew Cam Plus Lite
fixSteps.instruction: Services > Cam Plus Lite > set $0 or above.
